name: Build-Your-Own Taco Bowls
description: Rice bowls with seasoned beef or beans, corn, salsa, avocado, cheese, and crunchy tortilla chips.
notes: Set toppings out separately so everyone can build their own bowl.

name: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Potatoes
description: Lemon salmon roasted with baby potatoes and green beans for a clean one-pan dinner.
notes: Swap salmon for chicken thighs if fish is not on the menu.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta with Spinach
description: A comforting pasta dinner with tomato sauce, a splash of cream, spinach, and parmesan.
notes: Add white beans or grilled chicken for extra protein.

name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling chicken, peppers, and onions served with tortillas, yogurt, and lime.
notes: Make extra vegetables for lunch wraps the next day.

name: Lentil Bolognese
description: A rich tomato and lentil sauce served over spaghetti with parmesan and salad.
notes: The sauce freezes well, so double it when you have time.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Plates
description: Sticky teriyaki chicken with rice, cucumber, carrots, and steamed broccoli.
notes: Keep sauce on the side for anyone who prefers lighter seasoning.

name: Loaded Baked Potato Bar
description: Crispy baked potatoes with beans, cheese, yogurt, chives, salad, and optional bacon.
notes: Microwave potatoes first, then crisp them in the oven to save time.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Couscous
description: Herby turkey meatballs with couscous, cucumber tomato salad, and garlic yogurt.
notes: Bake the meatballs on parchment for a lower-mess version.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice with Eggs
description: Fast fried rice with bell peppers, carrots, eggs, soy sauce, and whatever vegetables need using.
notes: Best with chilled leftover rice.

name: Sausage and Gnocchi Skillet
description: Pan-crisped gnocchi with sausage, cherry tomatoes, greens, and mozzarella.
notes: Use vegetarian sausage if you want a meat-free version.

name: Mild Chickpea Coconut Curry
description: Creamy chickpea curry with coconut milk, tomatoes, spinach, and basmati rice.
notes: Serve chili flakes at the table for anyone who wants heat.

name: Personal Pita Pizzas
description: Individual pita pizzas with tomato sauce, mozzarella, vegetables, and simple salad.

name: Beef Stroganoff with Egg Noodles
description: Tender beef strips and mushrooms in a creamy sauce served over egg noodles.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A cozy pot of chicken, noodles, carrots, celery, and broth.

name: Vegetable Lasagna
description: Layered pasta with tomato sauce, roasted vegetables, ricotta, and mozzarella.

name: Greek Chicken Pitas
description: Warm pitas filled with chicken, cucumber, tomato, lettuce, and tzatziki.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apples

name: Black Bean Quesadillas

name: Sweet Potato Chili

name: Chicken Caesar Wraps

name: Mushroom Risotto

name: BBQ Chicken Flatbreads

name: Turkey Taco Soup
